name: concrete fatigue damage
definition_zh: 混凝土在循环荷载作用下逐步积累的材料损伤。
usage_overview: 在列车—轨道及基础结构动力分析中，表征混凝土受车辆重复荷载产生的累积劣化，并通过损伤变量更新结构刚度，用于分析疲劳损伤的演化及其与动力响应的相互作用。

complete_examples.text: Considering cyclic load on the CRTS III slab ballastless tracks, full-scale experimental tests with 4 million times of fatigue loading were conducted in [18] to reveal the three stages of fatigue damage evolution of slab ballastless track and validate a new concrete fatigue damage constitutive model based on a bundle-china model.
